decision: PARTIAL -> W1: author the page's figure. usu_ext lemongrass-in-the-garden states "Lemongrass divisions should be spaced 3 feet apart in the garden" -> in_row [36,36]; no row figure (not_authored). Today's [24,36] has no page for 24 (the NCSU toolbox 'Available Space To Plant: 12 inches-3 feet' is a footprint, W5; UC MG and UF give size only). The one restatement ('Space clumps 2 to 3 feet apart') is re-authored to about 3 feet.

edits.new: With frost danger past and the soil warming, harden off the plant over several days and set it in full sun in rich, well-drained soil. Space clumps about 3 feet apart. Water in well and keep the soil moist while it establishes.
edits.reason: restates the moved in-row figure (USU: 3 ft)
